title: Purchase Repayment
applicability: Applies to installment payments submitted by a third-party installment provider or payment facilitator (Buy-Now-Pay-Later / post-purchase repayment) for Visa and MasterCard Segment 100 transactions.
source: docs/specs/extracted_text.txt Appendix AB-1; cross-referenced at Appendix I-42 and Appendix K-25

businessRequirements.title: The Consumer Bill Payment/Purchase Repayment indicator value 'CB' shall be used only for Visa transactions, and value 'IR' shall be used only for MasterCard transactions.
For MasterCard Purchase Repayment transactions, the merchant shall submit the Installment Payment Indicator value 'I' in Segment 111 Table ID 013 (Special Payments Indicator Information).
For MasterCard Purchase Repayment transactions, the merchant shall submit the Merchant Name in Segment 111 Table ID 047 (Soft Descriptor) in the format 'Installment Provider name*Merchant name'.

A decline for a merchant not registered for the Purchase Repayment program shall return Merchant Advice Code 22 ('Merchant does not qualify for product code') when the merchant sent the Merchant Advice Code acceptance indicator (Table ID 049 Sub Table 07 = 'Y').
